mapper.select: SELECT dt.*, ua.display_name operator_name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM deposit_transaction rev WHERE rev.original_transaction_id=dt.id) is_reversed FROM deposit_transaction dt LEFT JOIN user_account ua ON ua.id=dt.operated_by WHERE dt.admission_id=#{admissionId} ORDER BY dt.transaction_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deposit_transaction(admission_id, transaction_no, request_no, transaction_type, amount, payment_method, note, operated_by) VALUES(#{admissionId}, #{transactionNo}, #{requestNo}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{note}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM deposit_transaction WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deposit_transaction(admission_id, transaction_no, transaction_type, amount, original_transaction_id, payment_method, note, operated_by) VALUES(#{admissionId}, #{transactionNo}, 'REVERSAL', #{amount}, #{originalId}, #{paymentMethod}, #{reason}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, c.item_code_snapshot item_code, c.item_name_snapshot item_name, c.item_type_snapshot item_type, c.unit_snapshot unit, mo.id order_id, mo.order_no FROM charge_detail c LEFT JOIN execution_record er ON er.id=c.execution_id LEFT JOIN order_item oi ON oi.id=er.order_item_id LEFT JOIN medical_order mo ON mo.id=oi.medical_order_id AND mo.admission_id=c.admission_id WHERE c.admission_id=#{admissionId} ORDER BY c.charged_at DESC,c.id DESC

SELECT a.id admission_id, a.status, db.deposit_balance, db.total_charge, db.available_balance, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_order mo WHERE mo.admission_id=a.id AND mo.status IN ('DRAFT','SUBMITTED','IN_PROGRESS')) pending_order_count, GREATEST(db.total_charge-db.deposit_balance,0) amount_due, GREATEST(db.deposit_balance-db.total_charge,0) refund_amount FROM admission a JOIN v_admission_deposit_balance db ON db.admission_id=a.id WHERE a.id=#{admissionId}

SELECT s.*, a.admission_no, p.name patient_name, ua.display_name settled_by_name FROM settlement s JOIN admission a ON a.id=s.admission_id JOIN patient p ON p.id=a.patient_id LEFT JOIN user_account ua ON ua.id=s.settled_by WHERE s.admission_id=#{admissionId}
SELECT * FROM settlement_detail WHERE settlement_id=#{settlementId} ORDER BY category
mapper.update: UPDATE account_alert SET status='RESOLVED', resolved_by=#{userId}, resolved_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='OPEN'
